name: Rotating Fireplace
oracle_text:
This artifact enters tapped with a time counter on it.
{T}: Add an amount of {C} equal to the number of time counters on this artifact.
{4}, {T}: Time travel. Activate only as a sorcery. (For each suspended card you own and each permanent you control with a time counter on it, you may add or remove a time counter.)
blocked_sentences: {4}, {T}: Time travel. Activate only as a sorcery. (For each suspended card you own and each permanent you control with a time counter on it, you may add or remove a time counter.)

needs.what: an op that, for each suspended card the controller owns (in exile, suspended, with time counters) and each permanent they control with a time counter on it, lets them choose to add one time counter, remove one, or do nothing; removing the last time counter from a suspended card must cast it without paying its mana cost as suspend does (702.62), through the same counter-removed funnel
needs.why_existing_wont_do: for_each + choose_mode over add_counters/remove_counters is the near miss, but no selector key reads 'suspended' (has_counters in exile also matches non-suspended exiled cards with time counters), and the free cast on removing the last counter lives only in suspend's upkeep tick, so an effect removing it would strand the card in exile. The rest of the card is expressible: enters tapped with add_counters time on entry, and the mana ability is add_mana {C} with amount counters_on time on self; the activated ability's cost is mana {4} + tap with sorcery_speed_only.
